images.name: Clearway Energy Group
images.description: Clearway Energy Group LLC is a U.S. developer, owner and operator of wind, solar, battery-storage and flexible generation assets. Founded as an independent platform in 2018 and headquartered in San Francisco, Clearway currently reports approximately 13.6 GW of gross capacity across 27 states. The company serves utilities, corporate and institutional buyers, governments, community-choice aggregators and other power-market customers, largely through contracted generation. Global Infrastructure Partners acquired the predecessor NRG renewables platform in 2018 through GIP III entities. On September 12, 2022, TotalEnergies closed its purchase of 50% of Clearway from GIP, leaving GIP III and TotalEnergies as equal current owners. BlackRock is shown only as GIP's parent after the 2024 manager acquisition and Evergreen Infrastructure Fund has no Clearway ownership period. Listed affiliate Clearway Energy, Inc. remains a separate company. No later platform sale or signed ownership change was identified through August 23, 2026.
